hooks.command: cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); case "$cmd" in *"rm -rf"*|*"rm -fr"*) echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"재귀 삭제(rm -rf) 명령 — 실행 전 사용자 확인이 필요합니다"}}' ;; esac
jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; npx prettier --write --ignore-unknown "$f"; } 2>/dev/null || true
f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // ""'); case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx) out=$(npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1) || { echo "$out" >&2; exit 2; } ;; esac
